subject: Ask external ChatGPT with discriminating predicates instead of narrative status dumps

body.text: Use the proven reciprocal question/answer channel more aggressively but with less text. When a worker needs external-chatgpt, prefer an existing mesh question event whose body contains only: one unresolved predicate, the exact semantic/evidence witness refs, at most two competing hypotheses, the single observation/test that would discriminate them, and the coordination basis ref. Do not send a full run summary or raw trace. I can answer that packet with a counterexample, review_result, capability demand, or evidence-directed suggestion. If the question cannot be expressed this way, first compile it through the minimal-unsatisfied-core rule. This makes external-chatgpt another bounded derivation participant rather than a prose context sink.
